name: Max Cross
storyline:
Max sails the seven seas in search of a way to become whole again.
Every known creature of the ocean stands against him, some unknown too.
summary:
Procedurally generated levels, randomly spawned enemies, this fast paced endless platformer will have you sweating bullets. It's all about timing and reaction speeds, to see how far you can make it and if you can top the leaderboard.

It's easy to play but VERY difficult to master. Incrementally increasing difficulty the long you survive means the challenge grows along with your experience.

Mix and match 10 unique power-ups with 5 game-changing modifiers, creating over 50 possible combinations that can completely transform how you play.

The further you make it, the bigger the score—and the harder the game hits back.

No two runs are ever the same and it keeps you coming back for more.
